notes.title: 0.3.1 Patch Note. Gear System Overhaul
notes.content: [h2]New Content[/h2][p]You might have once wondered when dressing up your character, "Why couldn't I equip certain items, say, a mask and glasses, at the same time?" And that was exactly the issue that we were addressing for the past few months - we'd like your intuitive ideas to be delivered in the game. The long and short of it is that we've revamped the gear system in version 0.3.1.[/p][p]The equipment types are broken down into the following categories:[/p][p][b]Headgear, Glasses, Mask, Clothing, Body Armor, Chest Rig, Gloves, Belt, Pants, Shoes, Accessory[/b][/p][p]You can only equip a certain number of each gear type (e.g., only 1 pair of glasses, but maybe up to 2 pieces of clothes). Some equipment pieces, like the Punishment Hoof Helmet, count as multiple gear types (Headgear + Glasses + Mask). Such items, once equipped, will automatically remove any other items previously occupying slots of the same type.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/6bb16c029a2fc1e038c09fe958e18d6dc93fd6b6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/fa6a7bf7bf79fd00289f29e52f884f8c819bce72.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Does it mean that from now on we can layer up our clothes as if we were prepping for a budget flight? The answer is positive, as long as you've got enough space on you. In time, having ten rings on might not be such an outlandish idea.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/73801a8c94d9b546da689ec37c82073fb6b6439e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Character animations have been updated to accommodate the new equipment system. This optimizes existing movements, making them smoother and more natural. This also lays the groundwork for future updates with more character details.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/ae63c9b919ad0d553e7639b4ce93893119acbcbc.gif"][/img][/p][p]Additionally, a small toy gun has been added to the game.[/p][p][/p][h2]Optimizations[/h2][list][*][p]Optimized item drag-and-drop, increasing the priority of placing an item.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized player icons on the minimap. Zooming out enlarges the player icon for easier locating.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a font size option in the settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a tooltip for character attributes. Hovering over a character's card now shows some of their current attributes.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/229e3477e73b5322ba3fc5a94d2a67ba7c367cce.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where rapidly moving to the workbench caused items to be duplicated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players consumed stamina without rolling.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]In Closing[/h2][p]Thank you for the support. This update is a minor functional update, focusing mainly on optimization and underlying system iteration. There may not be any content updates for a while, as the game framework is currently stabilizing and improving. The next content update will be released when a more complete game flow and framework are ready.[/p]

notes.title: Steam Playtest - Patch Notes 0.2.5α
notes.content: [p]What's up, players? Crit Team dropping in! Sorry about the long wait. We've had too much on our plate over the past two months. But thank goodness, we've now finally broken free from those chores, phew! With that, we bring you the [b]0.2.5α[/b] update. This marks the start of another long-term maintenance. We'll be pushing forward with subsequent updates as soon as possible to refine the game's overall framework. Fingers crossed you dig it.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2][h3][b]System[/b][/h3][p]Different search points now have distinct SFX/background panels.[/p][p]Shelf-type search points now visually reflect loot richness.[/p][p]Suppressor-type muzzle attachments now modify gunfire sounds.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Dual Crosshair Aiming[/b][/h3][p]We noticed players occasionally lost track of their aim position while using auto-aim, resulting in missed tracking. The new dual crosshair system addresses this by locking the internal aim to targets and continuously showing the player's actual cursor position externally.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Map[/b][/h3][p][b]\[Origin-00-1963] Burning Grove[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Players must complete a series of linear missions to unlock this new map.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]New Abnormal Status[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Burned[/b]: Causes continuous damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fire Field[/b]: You are in a fire field, affected by smoke and heat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smoke[/b]: Accelerates stamina cost and causes continuous damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scorch[/b]: Causes continuous damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Filtered Air[/b]: Safeguards your respiratory system from environmental hazards but increases stamina cost[/p][/*][*][p][b]High Heat Protection[/b]: Insulates you from high temperatures, enabling uninterrupted operation in extreme heat.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]New Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Echostrider[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Pyromad[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Dimenshift Butterfly[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Special Enemy[/b]: Eerie Puppet[/p][/*][*][p][b]Special Enemy[/b]: Arson Doctor[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]新装备[/b][/h3][p]RS Private 41 35rd Magazine[/p][p]RS Private 43[/p][list][*][p]RS Private 43 35rd Magazine[/p][/*][*][p]RS Veteran 43 Folding Stock[/p][/*][/list][p]RS Veteran M[/p][list][*][p]RS Veteran M Solid Wood Grip[/p][/*][*][p]RS Veteran M Solid Wood Stock[/p][/*][*][p]RS Veteran M Barrel[/p][/*][*][p]RS Veteran M 30rd Magazine[/p][/*][/list][p]RS M1891[/p][list][*][p]RS 3.5x PE Sight[/p][/*][*][p]RS M1891 Standard Bolt[/p][/*][/list][p]SVG Lion M90 Master Red Dot G[/p][p]Wolff SnapPoint 6x Long Arm Scope G[/p][p]Hardened Chitin Dagger[/p][p]Fishbone Sickle[/p][p]Biomaterial Gas Mask[/p][p]PTN Heat Resistant Suit[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Items[/b][/h3][p]PVC Tape[/p][p]Fungus-Tuned Bio-Frequency Meter[/p][p]Reverse Mote[/p][p]"Purging Fire" Operation Plan[/p][p]Key to Laboratory - Equipment Storage Room[/p][p][i]Some crafting recipes have also been added.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Changes[/b][/h2][p]Updated the sprite of RS Veteran 47 and its attachments.[/p][p]Balanced the defense of T-Shirt (Black): [b]3 → 1[/b].[/p][p]Added a key-unlockable room to the Laboratory of \[Origin-00-1961] Forest Region.[/p][p]Changed terrain shape and collision.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/99abef500327c743d1de13ea7d43e083a1994cd1.png"][/img][/p][p]Increased default value for mini-map's height-based shading to better highlight impassable terrain.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/47206e1e2af74d10aa91aec787663599ba382f6f.png"][/img]Optimized stage selection screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/d5b5f5e45574e8e6e871676b71314349cf3dfeba.gif"][/img][/p][p]Improved perspective effect.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/361cc322dbce3db93fce122e8120aa6cf141fdf1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/8d12c940c6d77de6be3e18c882026be4459613a5.png"][/img][/h2][h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Hit effects are now triggered via server notification instead of client-side, providing clearer hit feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a duplicated English localization string.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several errors in English localization.[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing localization texts.[/p][/*][*][p]Attempted to fix an invisible wall near the valley.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a cursor display issue on the U.R.C. terminal screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Gunsmith issue on the transmitter panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where shooting could result in negative XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing models in some search points.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a missing wall in the safehouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a confusing guide instruction in the new player tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the furious status of Scary Highlander was lost. Mycomarked will now enrage Scary Highlander and enhance their abilities.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Note: We know this update lacks substantial new content. Our upcoming development focus will revolve around content expansion.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Alpha-0.2.3 Patch Note（No Such Place Playtest）
notes.content:
[h1]Additions[/h1]
- Added the explanation for the item's badge in its tooltip.

- Implemented some items that had already been added to the backend.

- Added screen effects for some visors.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/67bda5e40fe1c574d53ceadea1da1fce2f88f153.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/e22d9061a1b2e8d595da26c250252f91bca18df7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/f5d67dbfe8c9f1268773f5e789dfb6359519f499.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/57d80109eed07ebf7656199499c6dab3e4d2438c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/5e4583e7f8c0cc91b73d7c86a5e1ac70d58b470c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/bc055cf0ea6ef0435bea350dcb1d01b49d9893f5.png[/img]
[h1]Adjustments[/h1]
- Added additional spawn points to the right side of [Origin-00] area.

- [b]"Fish" [/b]no longer drops [b]Pure Biomass[/b].

- Increased drop rate of [b]"Fishbone"[/b] from [b]"Fish"[/b].

- Increased chance of [b]rainy weather[/b].

- Increased the spawn rate of [b]"Fish"[/b] during [b]rainy weather[/b].

- Renamed the [b]"Spread"[/b] attribute to [b]"Shooting Spread"[/b].

- Optimized the visual effects of toxic gas in [b]Valley[/b] by reducing the maximum opacity.

- Environmental Toxins in [b]Valley[/b] now ignore the agent's Armor.

- Increased Environmental Toxin's damage in [b]Valley[/b] from 1 → 5.

-[b] SVG Gel Face Mask[/b] no longer protects you against Environmental Toxins.

- [b]SVG Gel Desert Face Mask[/b] no longer protects you against Environmental Toxins.

- [b]Woven Sandals[/b] movement speed changed from 0.2 → 0.3.

- [b]Rubber Boots[/b] movement speed changed from -0.3 → -0.1.

- [b]PTN Blue Chemical Protection Plastic Boots[/b] movement speed changed from -0.4 → -0.2.

- Quick-moving items now prioritize backpacks over chest rigs.

- Attempted to optimize the visual guide effect of doors perpendicular to the camera.

- Changed start menu icon.
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed aiming not updating promptly after rolling.

- Fixed issue where quickly moving stacked items during crafting could cause item loss due to overflow.

- Fixed abnormal item stacking when sorting items.

- Fixed missing ground near a spawn point in [b]Residential Building[/b].

- Fixed a clipping issue with a safe in [b]Residential Building[/b].

- Fixed an overlapping door issue in [b]Laboratory[/b].

- Fixed a collision issue at a search point.

- Fixed inconsistency between carried ammo and reloaded ammo count.

.- Fixed infinite reloading with shotguns after reverting.

- Fixed an issue where tree stumps would block bullet trajectories.

- Fixed an issue where railings would block bullet trajectories.

- Fixed an issue where Fogman's corpse could still be targeted.

- Fixed abnormal attack speed when quickly switching weapons.

- Radiated Bananas can now be lethal.

notes.title: Alpha-0.2.2 Patch Note（No Such Place Playtest）
notes.content:
[h1]Adjustments[/h1]
- Optimized resources at search points in each stage of the Tutorial Level.

- The weather in [Origin-00] is now mostly sunny, with a 5:1 ratio of sunny to rainy days.

- Significantly reduced the spawn weight of "Fish" during rainy weather.

- Removed Fungal Matriarch from the enemy spawn pool of the rainy weather.

- Adjusted "Fish" attributes:
[list]
[*] Health: 1000→1500
[*] Damage: 35→45
[*] Attack speed: 0.75→1.25
[*] Vision range: 10→3
[*] Hearing range: 3→10
[*] Chance to trigger Fracture on hit: 100%→20%
[*] Skill EXP gain multiplier: 1→1.2
[/list]

- Fogman
[list]
[*] Skill EXP gain multiplier: 1→1.4
[/list]

- Scary Highlander
[list]
[*] Skill EXP gain multiplier: 1→1.4
[/list]

- Removed foggy weather from the random weather pool for the [Origin-00] map.

- Reduced the foggy weather trigger range for the Military Outpost. Weather now changes only when you enter the outpost, not in the surrounding area.

- Configured the key to the warehouse of Military Outpost.

- Ground drops in the Military Outpost are now randomized from the full attachment pool.

- Increased the amount of loot inside the warehouse of Military Outpost.

- Removed the Trap in the Laboratory to ensure Scary Highlander moves correctly within the Valley area.

- Optimized the attack range of the Ice Axe.

- Added scroll bars to the chat and mail interfaces in the U.R.C. Terminal.

- Added chase range limits for hostile creatures.

- You can now select items directly from the Storage Box while on the terminal interface to submit and complete missions.

- Optimized EXP requirements for leveling up the Cardio skill:
[list]
[*] Level 1: 100→50
[*] Level 2: 320→160
[*] Level 3: 1200→600
[*] Level 4: 5000→2500
[*] Balanced corruption affixes:
[*] Spread of High Heat Fusion: -0.05 → -0.15
[*] Damage of Achilles' Aim: 5% → 12%
[/list]

[h1]
Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed several level design errors.
- Fixed a bug where the main interface disappeared due to network issues.
- Fixed an issue where opening/closing the crafting interface while the transmitter was open caused transmitter items to enlarge.
- Fixed an issue where the discard item prompt obscured the inventory bar.
- Fixed UI display errors on the character card.
- Fixed a slight misalignment in the Fogman's attack animation.
- Fixed an issue where firing sometimes failed while aiming.
- Fixed the missing Recyclable tag.
- Fixed a text error in a mission description.
- Fixed an issue where the corruption effect of Broken Lens did not match its description.
- Fixed an issue where resetting settings did not fully reset key bindings.
- Fixed an issue where closing the workbench interface displayed the merchant interface.
- Fixed an issue where merchant information did not update after trading.
- Fixed mismatched locations between File Piles and their search trigger.
- Fixed a bug where the purchase price of some items was much lower than their selling price.
- Fixed fire rate issues.

[h3]◆游戏介绍◆[/h3]
《No Such Place》是一款射击撤离类游戏。你将作为调查“超自然异常”的U.R.C组织一员，前往跌落维度破口的无人地区进行勘察。你需要独自在周围地区展开探索，搜集/制作食物、药品、武器装备等物资，击败沿途的未知怪物，在限定时间内找到撤离点以完成任务。
注意：当前版本仅单人游玩，暂不支持多人联机。
